summary: Reports complete on large tenants, and you set the support level in the Invardia portal.

new.title: Set the support level in Invardia portal
new.text: The Invardia Support app's access level (none, troubleshoot or setup) now follows what you set in the Invardia customer portal.

fixes.title: Reports complete on large tenants
fixes.text: Attack path and administrator sign-in reports could end incomplete on a large tenant. SecurityInsight now waits, asks again and works in parts, so the reports complete with the same rows.

fixes.title: Device reports work on Defender for Business
fixes.text: The missing CVE, recommendation and end-of-support software reports now return rows when Defender has no device inventory, for example Defender for Business. Open findings keep their history.

fixes.title: Heavy jobs get more computing power
fixes.text: Collections, correlation, Risk Analysis, the data sync and vulnerabilities now get more computing power and memory. No job is ever made smaller.

fixes.title: A stopped run is partial, not failed
fixes.text: A collection stopped by an update, by support or by a person is now reported as partial, with that reason. Only a run that itself failed is reported as failed.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: Stopping a run and updating is one checked step. The one-time cut-off now reads its own setting back correctly.
